title: Friction and Viscosity
heading: Friction and Viscosity
supportSummary: Movement meets resistance from its environment, not only from its own inertia.
Some systems slow because the medium around them creates drag and wasted effort.
Wise judgment reduces unnecessary friction and respects the difference between healthy resistance and avoidable drag.
